name: .338 Cal-246gr Hammer Hunter®

ballisticCoefficients.note: Hammer Bullets: "G7-BC= .279"; the method is not stated.

note: Recommended use: Big Game Hunting. The product page also says: "Your guys that have been running the 250gr class of bullets in your big 338’s will really like the added vel of the 246gr Hammer Hunter™™ with it’s secant ogive giving good bc for those longer shots. With our PDR drive bands this Hammer should pick up at least 100 fps over the conventional 250gr bullets."
